name: Test Edge
soul: The soul of no one: a test edge, kept for the engine's tests only.
spark: A test mote, kept for the engine's tests only.

hybrid.text: It is a test of the test edge.

settled.text: A test settled form of the test edge, kept for the engine's tests only.
settled.sign: A stranger would notice the mark of Small test edge on it.
settled.habit: When nothing is happening, Small test edge counts to itself.
